SPRINT 2 — InkOS Analytics P0 Bug Fixes. Project: /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS

Sprint 1 (Foundation) is COMPLETE. Approved plan: /Users/yashbaldha/.claude/plans/anaystics-page-lets-deep-fizzy-turtle.md

## What Sprint 1 already shipped (don't redo)
- `lib/analytics/range.ts` — parseRange, priorRange, rangeDays, pickGroupBy
- `lib/csv-export.ts` — papaparse wrapper
- `hooks/use-export-csv.ts` + `components/reports/AnalyticsExportProvider.tsx` — registry pattern
- `components/reports/AnalyticsToolbar.tsx` — DateRangePicker + Compare toggle + Export CSV button
- Layout renamed "Analytics"
- All 6 API routes accept `from/to/compare`, return `{ current, prior? }`
- All 6 client components read URL params and key React Query
- Heatmap CSS bug pulled forward — now uses `color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-onyx) ${pct}%, transparent)` instead of broken HSL
- Bookings API: null `service_id` now grouped as "Walk-in / Unscheduled"

## Sprint 2 Goal
Stop the bookings tab from looking broken. Every remaining P0 root cause fixed.

## Constraints (mandatory load)
- /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/CLAUDE.md sections 4 (Brand), 5 (UI), 7 (Architecture), 8 (Forbidden), 9 (Antipatterns)
- Brand: ONLY Bone/Onyx/Stone/Rust. Tabular-nums on every number. Custom shadow tokens only.
- No `any`, no `@ts-ignore`, no `console.log` (use lib/logger.ts)
- Zod for input validation

## Tasks (execute in order)

### 1. Extract & upgrade `components/reports/charts/BookingsHeatmap.tsx` (NEW)
Move HeatmapCell + grid render from `BookingsReportClient.tsx` into a dedicated component. Upgrade per audit:

- **Constrain hours to 10–22** (business hours, 13 cells × 7 rows). Default to 10–22; accept `hourRange` prop with default `[10, 22]` for future flexibility.
- **Floor opacity 6%** for zero cells using Stone tint, NOT Onyx (audit: "min Stone tint so grid is visible"). Use `color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-stone) 6%, transparent)` for zero, ramp to `color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-onyx) ${pct}%, transparent)` as intensity grows. Peak intensity (max heat) ramps to Rust accent for the single hottest cell — `color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-rust) 80%, transparent)`. This gives Stone→Onyx→Rust ramp matching brand 4-color rule.
- **Day order Sun→Sat** (US convention, current behavior — keep).
- **ARIA labels** per cell: `Mon 14:00 — 3 bookings` (not just "3 bookings"). Hour header uses `role="columnheader"`, day label uses `role="rowheader"`.
- **Hour labels** every 2h (10, 12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 22) — currently every 6h on full 24 grid; recompute for 10-22.
- Keyboard nav: each cell `tabIndex={0}` so screen readers + keyboard users can step through.
- Server filter: API still emits 7×24, but BookingsHeatmap slices to hours 10-22 client-side. Or server-side trim to hours 10-22 — either fine, prefer server-side to reduce payload (in `app/api/reports/bookings/route.ts:84-89`).

Props:
```ts
interface BookingsHeatmapProps {
  data: number[][]      // 7×N grid
  hourStart?: number    // default 10
  hourEnd?: number      // default 22 (inclusive)
}
```

Export from index, update `BookingsReportClient.tsx` to import.

### 2. Build `components/reports/charts/StatusBreakdownBar.tsx` (NEW)
Stacked horizontal bar component reconciling all booking statuses to total.

```ts
interface StatusBreakdownBarProps {
  statuses: Array<{ key: string; label: string; count: number; tone: 'success' | 'neutral' | 'destructive' }>
  total: number
}
```

Color map (brand-locked):
- `success` → Onyx fill (completed)
- `neutral` → Stone fill (pending, confirmed, in_progress, rescheduled)
- `destructive` → Rust fill (no_show, cancelled)

Render:
- Single horizontal bar, height ~32px, rounded ends
- Each segment width proportional to count/total
- Below the bar: legend with colored dot + label + count + percent
- Tabular-nums on every number
- Mobile: legend wraps, bar stays full-width

A11y: `role="img" aria-label="Booking status breakdown: 77 completed, 9 no-show, 10 cancelled, 54 upcoming, 150 total"`

### 3. Update `app/api/reports/bookings/route.ts` — full status breakdown + heatmap trim
Add `statusBreakdown` to `BookingsBlock`:
```ts
interface StatusBreakdown {
  completed: number
  no_show: number
  cancelled: number
  pending: number
  confirmed: number
  in_progress: number
  rescheduled: number
}
```
Reduce all bookings into this map. Each booking lands in exactly one bucket (or "other" if status is unknown — log warning via `logger.warn`). Sum must equal `total`.

Trim heatmap server-side to hours 10–22 (13 cells × 7 days). Update interface comment.

### 4. Update `components/reports/BookingsReportClient.tsx` — 6→3 KPI cards + status breakdown
Replace 6 KPI cards with 3 (audit-mandated):

- **Total Bookings** — value=total, subtextLabel="in period"
- **Completion rate** — value=`{completionRate}%` (computed: completed/total*100), subtextLabel=`{completed} sessions completed`
- **No-show + Cancelled** — value=`{count}` (noShows+cancelled), subtextLabel=`{combinedRate}% of total`. Use Rust accent (KpiCard `accentVar="--color-rust"` if supported, else fallback).

Below KPI grid, render `<StatusBreakdownBar>` showing all 7 statuses summing to total. This kills the 54-unaccounted gap.

Replace `HeatmapCell` + grid with `<BookingsHeatmap data={d.heatmap} />`.

### 5. Verify seed has distinct service_ids
Run:
```bash
pnpm db:seed:demo:verify
```
Then query the seeded DB to check service_id distribution on bookings. If all bookings share one service_id, fix the seed in `scripts/seed/demo/`. Look for a bookings seed file. Each booking should pick a service_id from the studio's services array (~6+ services). Verify by: load `/reports/bookings` after seed → "Services by Popularity" shows distinct counts.

If seed file does indeed force a single service_id, fix it. If random spread is already there, the prior bug was just the null-handling case (already fixed Sprint 1).

### 6. Low Stock single source — `app/api/reports/inventory/route.ts` is truth
Verify both endpoints return matching counts:
- `GET /api/reports/inventory` → `kpis.lowStockCount`
- `GET /api/inventory/stock-alerts` → length of returned array

Strategy: keep both endpoints, but BOTH must use the same definition. Definition: `inventory_items.current_stock <= inventory_items.min_threshold` AND `min_threshold > 0` (don't trigger on items with no min set).

Update `app/api/inventory/stock-alerts/route.ts` to read from `inventory_items` directly with the same filter, deprecating the `stock_alerts` table read OR ensuring the trigger keeps `stock_alerts` in sync. Pick the simpler path: **read inventory_items directly in stock-alerts endpoint**, leave the table for now but stop relying on it. Add Dato note about future cleanup.

After change, verify: navigate `/reports/inventory` and `/inventory` → low stock counts match exactly on the same seed.

### 7. Add unit test
`tests/unit/reports/bookings-aggregation.test.ts` (Vitest) — covers:
- `serviceCounts` reducer with mixed/null/duplicate fixtures
- Status breakdown sums to total
- Heatmap dimensions correct (7×13 after trim)
- pickGroupBy thresholds (verify Sprint 1 lib too)

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `<BookingsHeatmap>` renders 7×13 grid, Stone-tint floor on zero cells, Onyx ramp, Rust at peak. Hours 10–22 only.
- [ ] Services list shows distinct counts per service (verify with `pnpm db:seed:demo:reset && pnpm dev`)
- [ ] Status breakdown bar — every booking accounted for (sum = total). No 54-missing.
- [ ] Bookings tab has 3 KPI cards (was 6)
- [ ] Low stock count identical on `/reports/inventory` and `/inventory` (verify in browser after seed)
- [ ] Heatmap keyboard-navigable, ARIA labels per cell `Mon 14:00 — 3 bookings`
- [ ] Mobile 375px: status bar + heatmap don't overflow

## Validation gates (mandatory)
After all edits run:
```bash
pnpm typecheck
pnpm lint
pnpm test  # if vitest configured
pnpm build
```
Fix every error before reporting done. If pre-existing build errors remain (`@anthropic-ai/sdk`, `NewCampaignButton`), note them but do not "fix" — they're outside this sprint's scope.

## Report format (caveman OK)
1. Files created (paths)
2. Files modified (paths)
3. Seed status — was distribution actually broken? what did you fix?
4. Validation gate results
5. Follow-ups for Sprint 3

12	type AlertRow = {

43	export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
44	  const ip = getClientIp(request)
45	  const { success } = await authedRatelimit.limit(ip)
46	  if (!success) return new Response('Too many requests', { status: 429 })
47	
48	  const supabase = await createClient()
49	  const {
50	    data: { user },
51	  } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
52	  if (!user) return new Response('Unauthorized', { status: 401 })
53	
54	  const { data: member } = await supabase
55	    .from('studio_members')
56	    .select('studio_id, role')
57	    .eq('user_id', user.id)
58	    .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
59	    .limit(1)
60	    .single()
61	  if (!member) return new Response('No studio membership', { status: 403 })
62	
63	  const { data: sub } = await supabase
64	    .from('subscriptions')
65	    .select('plan_tier')
66	    .eq('studio_id', member.studio_id)
67	    .eq('status', 'active')
68	    .maybeSingle()
69	  const plan = (sub?.plan_tier ?? 'solo') as PlanTier
70	  const gate = requireFeature(plan, 'inventory')
71	  if (gate) return gate
72	
73	  const url = new URL(request.url)
74	  const open_only = url.searchParams.get('open') !== 'false'
75	
76	  // Parallel: alerts + enriched item join, and no-min count — single DB round-trip each.
77	  let alertQuery = supabase
78	    .from('stock_alerts')
79	    .select(
80	      `
81	      id, studio_id, item_id, alert_type, current_stock, threshold,
82	      acknowledged_at, acknowledged_by, created_at, updated_at,
83	      inventory_items (
84	        id, name, sku, current_stock, min_threshold,
85	        cost_per_unit_cents, supplier_id,
86	        suppliers ( name )
87	      )
88	    `,
89	    )
90	    .eq('studio_id', member.studio_id)
91	    .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
92	
93	  if (open_only) alertQuery = alertQuery.is('acknowledged_at', null)
94	
95	  const [alertsResult, noMinResult] = await Promise.all([
96	    alertQuery,
97	    supabase
98	      .from('inventory_items')
99	      .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
100	      .eq('studio_id', member.studio_id)
101	      .eq('min_threshold', 0)
102	      .eq('is_active', true),
103	  ])
104	
105	  if (alertsResult.error) {
106	    logger.error({ err: alertsResult.error }, 'stock alerts GET failed')
107	    return Response.json({ error: 'Failed to fetch stock alerts' }, { status: 500 })
108	  }
109	
110	  if (noMinResult.error) {
111	    logger.error({ err: noMinResult.error }, 'stock alerts no-min count failed')
112	    return Response.json({ error: 'Failed to fetch no-min count' }, { status: 500 })
113	  }
114	
115	  const items_with_no_min = noMinResult.count ?? 0
116	
117	  // Shape the enriched rows — compute suggested_qty server-side.
118	  const alerts: AlertRow[] = (alertsResult.data ?? []).map((row) => {
119	    const item = row.inventory_items as
120	      | {
121	          id: string
122	          name: string
123	          sku: string | null
124	          current_stock: number
125	          min_threshold: number
126	          cost_per_unit_cents: number | null
127	          supplier_id: string | null
128	          suppliers: { name: string } | null
129	        }
130	      | null
131	
132	    const min_threshold = item?.min_threshold ?? row.threshold
133	    const current = item?.current_stock ?? row.current_stock
134	    const suggested_qty = Math.max(min_threshold * 2 - current, 1)
135	
136	    return {
137	      id: row.id,
138	      studio_id: row.studio_id,
139	      item_id: row.item_id,
140	      alert_type: row.alert_type,
141	      current_stock: row.current_stock,
142	      threshold: row.threshold,
143	      acknowledged_at: row.acknowledged_at,
144	      acknowledged_by: row.acknowledged_by,
145	      created_at: row.created_at,
146	      updated_at: row.updated_at,
147	      inventory_items: item
148	        ? {
149	            id: item.id,
150	            name: item.name,
151	            sku: item.sku,
152	            current_stock: item.current_stock,
153	            min_threshold: item.min_threshold,
154	            cost_per_unit_cents: item.cost_per_unit_cents,
155	            supplier_id: item.supplier_id,
156	            supplier_name: item.suppliers?.name ?? null,
157	          }
158	        : null,
159	      suggested_qty,
160	    }
161	  })
162	
163	  // Derive top-level state.
164	  let state: AlertState
165	  if (alerts.length > 0) {
166	    state = 'has_alerts'
167	  } else if (items_with_no_min > 0) {
168	    state = 'cant_fire'
169	  } else {
170	    state = 'all_clear'
171	  }
172	
173	  return Response.json({ data: alerts, state, items_with_no_min })
174	}

36	      total_price_cents: faker.number.int({ min: 150000, max: 400000 }),

44	      sessions_completed: 1,
45	      started_at: new Date(today.getTime() - 45 * 86400_000).toISOString(),

50	  log.module('bookings', projectRows.length, 'projects')
51	  ctx.projectIds = projectRows.map((r) => r.id)

32	): ParsedRange {
33	  const raw =
34	    searchParams instanceof URLSearchParams
35	      ? Object.fromEntries(searchParams.entries())
36	      : searchParams

39	  const data = parsed.success ? parsed.data : { from: undefined, to: undefined, compare: '0' as const }

43	    from: data.from ?? fallback.from,
44	    to: data.to ?? fallback.to,
45	  }
